## Summary
Senior Vice President of Engineering & Product with over a decade of hands-on systems architecture and executive leadership experience across the US, Europe, and India. Specializes in moving AI systems from prototypes to production SLAs: multi-agent workflows, LLM routing and FinOps controls, hybrid RAG, automated evaluation suites, distributed backends, cloud-native infrastructure, and internal developer platforms.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI & Agentic Systems:** Agentic AI, LLM Orchestration, AI Systems & Evals, MCP, Hybrid RAG, MLOps, NLP
- **Cloud & Distributed Scale:** Cloud Architecture (AWS), Distributed Systems, Microservices, Platform Engineering (IDP), Golang, Python, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, Docker, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL, OpenTelemetry
- **Leadership & Product:** Technical Leadership, Product Strategy, Global Team Scaling, AI Unit Economics & FinOps, Agile Delivery

## Career History

### Senior Vice President of Engineering & Product — microDrive (Feb 2022 – Present | Tampa, FL)
- Designed and led core AI social media intelligence platform using LLMs, NLP, and ML models to extract real-time audience insights from 50M+ daily posts.
- Set AI and product roadmap, shifting legacy marketing tools toward predictive analytics and automated agent workflows backed by evaluation checks.
- Ran company-wide migration from legacy monolith to Docker and Kubernetes microservices, cutting release cycles from weeks to hours at 99.95% availability.
- Built high-throughput streaming and ML data pipelines with Golang, Python, Kafka, and Redis handling 1M+ events/sec at 99.9% uptime.
- Rolled out an internal developer platform with automated code quality and security checks, cutting PR review time by 50% and catching 95% of vulnerabilities pre-deploy.
- Grew and managed cross-functional global engineering and product teams across architecture, hiring, and quarterly launches.
- Connected PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, and Salesforce into live executive reporting pipelines.

### Full-time Parenting (Career Break) — Self-Employed (Oct 2021 – Jan 2022 | Düsseldorf, DE)
- Four-month sabbatical focused on full-time parenting and family relocation from Germany back to the US.

### Vice President of Engineering — InfluencerDB (May 2020 – Oct 2021 | Cologne, DE)

- Designed scalable AWS (EC2, S3) backends and tuned heavy database workloads for analytical traffic spikes.
- Built real-time analytics applications and internal dashboards with Python and Apache Spark.
- Cleaned up legacy Python and JavaScript services, cutting codebase size by 50% while fixing critical defects and improving uptime.
- Partnered with Product and QA on user research, prototyping, gap analysis, and release sign-off.

## Engineering Case Studies

1. **Multi-Agent AI Workflow Orchestration Platform** (`https://dontula.com/projects/multi-agent-workflow-orchestration`)
   - **Impact:** 65% workflow automation · 99.2% policy compliance · <1.8s p95 step latency
   - **Stack:** Python, MCP, LangGraph, Redis, OpenTelemetry
   - **Summary:** Deterministic state-machine orchestrator wrapping bounded reasoning steps, centralized MCP tool gateway with per-tenant RBAC and audit logs, human-in-the-loop approval gates, and automated trajectory evals.

2. **Enterprise LLM Gateway & Intelligent Model Router** (`https://dontula.com/projects/enterprise-llm-gateway-router`)
   - **Impact:** 58% inference cost reduction · 3.2x faster p95 latency · 99.98% AI uptime
   - **Stack:** Golang, Redis, vLLM, Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry
   - **Summary:** Shared Golang proxy enforcing auth, PII redaction, Redis semantic/prefix caching, complexity-based routing across self-hosted distilled vLLM clusters and frontier APIs, plus automatic multi-provider failover.

3. **Hybrid RAG & Context Engineering Knowledge Engine** (`https://dontula.com/projects/hybrid-rag-context-engine`)
   - **Impact:** 94% citation groundedness · -70% hallucination rate · 450ms retrieval p95
   - **Stack:** Python, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Kafka, FastAPI
   - **Summary:** Event-driven Kafka chunking and ACL sync feeding ElasticSearch BM25 + pgvector hybrid search, strict query-time permission filtering, cross-encoder reranking, and citation verification.

4. **AI-Powered Social Media Intelligence Platform** (`https://dontula.com/projects/social-media-intelligence-platform`)
   - **Impact:** 50M+ posts/day at sub-second latency · +35% sentiment accuracy
   - **Stack:** Python, LLMs & NLP, Kafka, React, AWS
   - **Summary:** Kappa streaming architecture (Kafka + Spark Streaming) feeding fine-tuned sentiment/NER transformers and selective LLM crisis briefings indexed in ElasticSearch.

5. **Intelligent Chat Routing System** (`https://dontula.com/projects/intelligent-chat-routing-system`)
   - **Impact:** -25% handle time · -40% transfers · +60% faster first response
   - **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, NLP & ML, Redis, Docker
   - **Summary:** Two-stage intent and sentiment triage pipeline matching live customer messages to the best available support specialist.

6. **Scalable ML & AI Evaluation Infrastructure** (`https://dontula.com/projects/scalable-ml-pipeline`)
   - **Impact:** Deployment cut from weeks to hours · 15+ production models
   - **Stack:** Python, Kubernetes, Airflow, MLflow, Terraform
   - **Summary:** Shared Kubernetes MLOps platform with a central Feature Store, GPU training pools, automated drift checks, and canary serving.

7. **Real-Time Data Analytics Dashboard** (`https://dontula.com/projects/real-time-analytics-dashboard`)
   - **Impact:** <200ms end-to-end latency · 50k+ events/sec · Zero downtime
   - **Stack:** Golang, React, D3.js, InfluxDB, WebSocket
   - **Summary:** High-concurrency Golang stream processor with statistical anomaly detection and live WebSocket UI updates.

8. **Microservices Architecture Migration** (`https://dontula.com/projects/microservices-architecture-migration`)
   - **Impact:** 99.99% uptime · 2x deployment frequency · Zero big-bang risk
   - **Stack:** Java, Spring Boot, Docker, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ
   - **Summary:** Phased 9-month Strangler Fig breakup of a 10-year monolith behind an API Gateway with isolated per-domain schemas and async messaging.

9. **Internal Developer & AI Code Quality Platform** (`https://dontula.com/projects/automated-code-quality-platform`)
   - **Impact:** -50% PR review time · 95% pre-deploy vulnerability catch rate
   - **Stack:** Python, CI/CD, SonarQube, Docker, DevSecOps
   - **Summary:** Automated PR verification layer combining AST checks, SAST/CVE/secret gates, and historical defect risk scoring.
